fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSM) October revenue beat expectations at NT$586.89B, up 14.7% month-over-month and 59.7% year-over-year, signaling strong start to Q4.
fields.summary_ko.1: Wedbush maintained NT$3,300 price target and reconfirmed 'Outperform' rating; Q4 expected to show ~13% sequential revenue growth, with currency fluctuations likely impacting operating margin by ~0.4% per 1% margin swing.
